parallel-matched-predictions.claim_text: ML and mechanistic models can be deployed simultaneously over a shared, measurable output space, with matched perturbation conditions, so their predictions are directly comparable.

candidates.paper_title: Large language models encode clinical knowledge

useful_outcomes.rationale: Med-PaLM benchmarks LLM accuracy on MedQA but does not match outputs against a mechanistic model under shared conditions.

immediate_benefit.rationale: WCM teams cannot directly reuse clinical-QA evaluations as ML/MM matched-prediction baselines.

plausible.rationale: Methodology of benchmark evaluation against multiple held-out QA datasets is rigorous and reproducible.

scalable.rationale: Demonstrates LLM scaling laws but only along QA tasks, not biological output spaces.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides structured human-evaluation rubric (factuality, harm, bias) transferable to comparing model outputs.

candidates.paper_title: SRAMP: prediction of mammalian N6-methyladenosine (m6A) sites based on sequence-derived features

useful_outcomes.rationale: Builds an ML predictor for m6A sites but never compares to a mechanistic model on a shared output space.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Sequence-feature classifiers reusable but not directly as parallel-paradigm baselines for WCMs.

plausible.rationale: Standard supervised-learning pipeline with cross-validation is methodologically sound.

scalable.rationale: Per-site classifier scales to transcriptome but is narrow in modality.

how_to_validate.rationale: Reports AUC on independent test sets — a borrowable evaluation pattern for matched predictions.

candidates.paper_title: A large-scale evaluation of computational protein function prediction

useful_outcomes.rationale: CAFA demonstrates 54 methods evaluated on the same 866-protein output space — exactly the matched-prediction setup.

immediate_benefit.rationale: WCM teams can adopt the CAFA pattern of matched targets and shared scoring metrics now.

plausible.rationale: Community-wide blinded benchmark with consistent metrics is methodologically exemplary.

scalable.rationale: Framework scales to many models and many proteins; conceptually portable to whole-cell readouts.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides explicit precision-recall and term-centric metrics as a validation template.

candidates.paper_title: Inferring causation from time series in Earth system sciences

useful_outcomes.rationale: Reviews data-driven causal methods alongside mechanistic Earth-system models — analogous parallel-paradigm setting.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Causal-inference benchmarks could be repurposed for ML/MM comparison but require adaptation to cells.

plausible.rationale: Establishes rigorous benchmarking framework for causal discovery against simulated ground truth.

scalable.rationale: Methods scale to high-dimensional time series but not yet whole-cell complexity.

how_to_validate.rationale: Proposes synthetic-data benchmarks with known causal graphs — a borrowable validation strategy.

candidates.paper_title: Deep Neural Networks Rival the Representation of Primate IT Cortex for Core Visual Object Recognition

useful_outcomes.rationale: Directly compares DNN representations and primate IT cortex on the same image set — paradigmatic matched-prediction example.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Representational-similarity protocol borrowable for matching ML/MM cellular predictions on shared inputs.

plausible.rationale: Uses representational dissimilarity matrices and behavioural metrics — well-validated comparison methodology.

scalable.rationale: Approach scales to deeper networks but visual-cortex domain is narrower than whole-cell.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides explicit kernel-based comparison metrics readily applicable to matched predictions.

candidates.paper_title: Skilful precipitation nowcasting using deep generative models of radar

useful_outcomes.rationale: Compares deep generative ML against numerical weather-prediction models on the same radar fields — matched-output paradigm.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Comparative evaluation framework directly transferable; cellular analog requires re-mapping.

plausible.rationale: Triple-evaluation (statistical, economic, cognitive) of skill is methodologically strong.

scalable.rationale: Framework scales to large operational domains; concept extends to whole-cell readouts.

how_to_validate.rationale: Ranking by expert meteorologists provides a forecast-value validation template.

candidates.paper_title: Quantifying climate feedbacks in polar regions

useful_outcomes.rationale: Quantifies feedbacks in mechanistic climate models but not against ML predictions on shared outputs.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Feedback-decomposition framework is mechanistic-only and hard to repurpose immediately.

plausible.rationale: Methodology for radiative kernel decomposition is well-established.

scalable.rationale: Scales to many GCMs but does not directly target ML/MM matched outputs.

how_to_validate.rationale: Process-oriented evaluation is borrowable but not specific to matched predictions.

candidates.paper_title: Changing Data Sources in the Age of Machine Learning for Official Statistics

useful_outcomes.rationale: Discusses ML-driven official statistics but no matched-prediction comparison with mechanistic models.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Topic is data-source drift in statistics; minimal direct WCM applicability.

plausible.rationale: Survey-style methodology is reasonable but not empirically demonstrative.

scalable.rationale: Statistical-survey framing does not scale to mechanistic-cell complexity.

how_to_validate.rationale: Generic data-quality recommendations only loosely transferable.

candidates.paper_title: Learning Curves for Decision Making in Supervised Machine Learning: A Survey

useful_outcomes.rationale: Surveys learning curves for sample-size decisions; not a matched-prediction comparison.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Useful for sizing ML training sets but not for parallel-paradigm output matching.

plausible.rationale: Survey is methodologically thorough across algorithms and applications.

scalable.rationale: Concepts apply broadly but do not address mechanistic-model comparison.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides protocols for evaluating learners but not joint ML/MM evaluation.

candidates.paper_title: DOME: Recommendations for supervised machine learning validation in biology

useful_outcomes.rationale: Provides DOME validation checklist applicable when matching ML predictions against mechanistic outputs.

immediate_benefit.rationale: WCM teams can adopt DOME criteria today to standardise ML-side reporting in matched comparisons.

plausible.rationale: Community-derived recommendations are widely endorsed and reproducible.

scalable.rationale: Generic checklist scales across biological prediction tasks including whole-cell.

how_to_validate.rationale: Explicit data-optimization-model-evaluation framework is a directly borrowable validation template.

parallel-agreement-disagreement.claim_text: Agreement between ML and MM predictions increases confidence in joint outputs; disagreement localises epistemic uncertainty — missing data, missing mechanism, or incorrect assumption.

candidates.paper_title: GWTC-1: A Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog of Compact Binary Mergers Observed by LIGO and Virgo during the First and Second Observing Runs

useful_outcomes.rationale: Detection requires agreement between matched-filter and unmodelled searches — concrete agreement-as-confidence pattern.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Multi-pipeline agreement protocol transferable to ML/MM joint detection in cells.

plausible.rationale: Three independent search pipelines with calibrated false-alarm rates are exemplary methodology.

scalable.rationale: Pipeline scales over thousands of candidate events; concept generalises across scales.

how_to_validate.rationale: Quantitative false-alarm-rate cross-validation across pipelines is a borrowable strategy.

candidates.paper_title: Reproducibility in density functional theory calculations of solids

useful_outcomes.rationale: Compares 15 DFT codes on identical crystals — paradigmatic disagreement-localises-assumption study.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Delta-test cross-code comparison is directly portable as a WCM ensemble-agreement protocol.

plausible.rationale: Community study with controlled inputs and quantitative agreement metric is rigorous.

scalable.rationale: Scales to dozens of codes and many materials; analogous to multi-WCM/ML comparison.

how_to_validate.rationale: Defines explicit Delta metric for pairwise agreement — directly borrowable validation tool.

candidates.paper_title: Uncertainty-informed deep learning models enable high-confidence predictions for digital histopathology

useful_outcomes.rationale: Demonstrates that uncertainty thresholds isolate high- vs low-confidence ML predictions — directly supports agreement-as-confidence.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Dropout-based uncertainty calibration is immediately adoptable for ML side of WCM comparisons.

plausible.rationale: Standard MC-dropout with thresholds derived from training data is methodologically sound.

scalable.rationale: Approach scales to whole-slide imaging; cross-modality scaling not yet shown.

how_to_validate.rationale: Reports calibration plots and abstention rates — useful validation pattern for joint outputs.

candidates.paper_title: Large-scale DNA-based phenotypic recording and deep learning enable highly accurate sequence-function mapping

useful_outcomes.rationale: Sequence-function mapping is impressive but does not explicitly compare ML vs mechanistic predictions for agreement.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Provides a high-throughput phenotype recording usable as ground-truth for ML/MM agreement studies.

plausible.rationale: Recombinase-based phenotypic recording is experimentally validated and reproducible.

scalable.rationale: Approach scales to millions of GREs — a relevant data substrate for cell-scale comparisons.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides held-out test prediction accuracy but no joint MM/ML disagreement metric.

candidates.paper_title: Lightning Pose: improved animal pose estimation via semi-supervised learning, Bayesian ensembling and cloud-native open-source tools

useful_outcomes.rationale: Bayesian ensemble disagreement flags uncertain frames — supports disagreement-as-uncertainty principle.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Open-source ensembling tools transferable to WCM ensemble-agreement workflows.

plausible.rationale: Semi-supervised learning with ensemble-based uncertainty is methodologically sound.

scalable.rationale: Scales to videos but not directly to whole-cell modalities.

how_to_validate.rationale: Demonstrates cross-validation of ensemble disagreement against held-out human labels.

candidates.paper_title: Deep learning-enabled segmentation of ambiguous bioimages with deepflash2

useful_outcomes.rationale: Uses multi-expert annotations and deep ensembles to flag disagreement on ambiguous images — direct analog to claim.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Tool can be applied today to bioimage workflows; broader WCM adoption needs adaptation.

plausible.rationale: Ensemble methodology with multi-rater ground truth is robust.

scalable.rationale: Scales to many bioimage tasks but is image-modality specific.

how_to_validate.rationale: Quantifies inter-annotator vs model disagreement — borrowable validation pattern.

candidates.paper_title: Am I Confused or Is This Confusing?: Deep Ensembles for ENSO Uncertainty Quantification

useful_outcomes.rationale: Deep ensembles deployed alongside Earth-system models for ENSO — direct ML/MM agreement-disagreement study.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Methodology is preprint but framework is reusable for WCM ensemble UQ.

plausible.rationale: Probabilistic neural-network ensembles with formal aleatoric/epistemic decomposition is sound.

scalable.rationale: Scales to climate ensembles; cell-scale generalisation not demonstrated.

how_to_validate.rationale: Compares ensemble disagreement against CESM2-LE benchmark — concrete validation route.

candidates.paper_title: Credal Ensemble Distillation for Uncertainty Quantification

useful_outcomes.rationale: Distills ensemble disagreement into single model with epistemic/aleatoric split — supports disagreement-as-uncertainty.

immediate_benefit.rationale: CED framework is novel but applicable for compressing WCM-side ensembles.

plausible.rationale: Credal-set formulation with class-wise probability intervals is theoretically sound.

scalable.rationale: Distillation reduces inference cost — scales to large WCM ensembles.

how_to_validate.rationale: Validates against ensemble baselines on classification benchmarks; biology validation absent.

candidates.paper_title: Deep Ensembles for Epistemic Uncertainty: A Frequentist Perspective

useful_outcomes.rationale: Provides theoretical grounding for epistemic-uncertainty decomposition via ensemble disagreement.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Frequentist framework usable for WCM-ensemble disagreement analysis with adaptation.

plausible.rationale: Theoretical analysis grounded in mutual-information bounds is rigorous.

scalable.rationale: Generic to any ensemble; scales to large models.

how_to_validate.rationale: Limited empirical validation — mostly theory; less actionable for WCM teams.

candidates.paper_title: Towards Integrating Epistemic Uncertainty Estimation into the Radiotherapy Workflow

useful_outcomes.rationale: Uses epistemic uncertainty to flag OOD scenarios — operational example of disagreement isolating gaps.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Workflow integration patterns transferable to ML/MM disagreement triggers in WCM pipelines.

plausible.rationale: Standard deep-learning UQ methodology applied in clinical context with validation.

scalable.rationale: Application-specific; concept scales but implementation domain-bound.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides OOD-detection validation protocol applicable to ML/MM disagreement assessment.

parallel-foundation-models.claim_text: Recent single-cell and cross-species foundation models supply mechanism-agnostic predictions over the same generative biology that mechanistic WCMs target, making them practical ML-side parallel baselines.

candidates.paper_title: Large language models encode clinical knowledge

useful_outcomes.rationale: Med-PaLM is a large foundation model demonstrating mechanism-agnostic clinical predictions, but not single-cell biology.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Instruction-prompt-tuning recipe applicable to bio foundation models for WCM-comparable outputs.

plausible.rationale: Rigorous benchmarking with human-evaluation rubric is methodologically strong.

scalable.rationale: Demonstrates scaling laws across model sizes — relevant to bio foundation-model training.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides MultiMedQA benchmark and human-eval framework as validation templates.

candidates.paper_title: Segment anything in medical images

useful_outcomes.rationale: MedSAM foundation model unifies segmentation across modalities — analog for WCM-side foundation baselines on imaging readouts.

immediate_benefit.rationale: MedSAM weights publicly available for cell-segmentation benchmarking against MM predictions.

plausible.rationale: Trained on 1.57M image-mask pairs with comprehensive evaluation across 10 modalities.

scalable.rationale: Foundation-model design scales across modalities and tasks — transferable pattern.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides extensive cross-modality and cross-task validation protocol borrowable for WCM imaging.

candidates.paper_title: Foundation models for generalist medical artificial intelligence

useful_outcomes.rationale: Defines GMAI paradigm covering multimodal genomics/imaging/EHR — direct conceptual blueprint for WCM-side foundation baselines.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Vision paper rather than implementation; concepts immediately adoptable for design.

plausible.rationale: Conceptual framework grounded in established self-supervision and multimodal pretraining.

scalable.rationale: Argues for multimodal scaling from imaging to genomics — high-relevance scaling roadmap.

how_to_validate.rationale: Discusses validation considerations but does not provide concrete WCM benchmarks.

candidates.paper_title: Scaling deep learning for materials discovery

useful_outcomes.rationale: GNoME ML predicts stable materials cross-checked against DFT — direct ML/MM parallel-baseline pattern.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Workflow blueprint transferable but materials-specific; cellular reuse needs adaptation.

plausible.rationale: Trained on 380K stable structures with 736 experimentally realized — exceptional rigor.

scalable.rationale: Scales to 2.2M discoveries — order-of-magnitude expansion demonstrates foundation-scale ML.

how_to_validate.rationale: Convex-hull and experimental-realization metrics are concrete cross-validation strategies.

candidates.paper_title: A foundation model for generalizable disease detection from retinal images

useful_outcomes.rationale: RETFound demonstrates foundation-model label-efficient adaptation across diseases — generalizes idea to bio FM baselines.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Retinal-image specific but recipe (SSL on unlabelled data + fine-tuning) is reusable.

plausible.rationale: Trained on 1.6M unlabelled retinal images with multi-disease downstream evaluation.

scalable.rationale: Demonstrates scaling of self-supervised learning in biomedical imaging.

how_to_validate.rationale: Reports adaptation to many tasks with comparison models — explicit validation template.

candidates.paper_title: A whole-slide foundation model for digital pathology from real-world data

useful_outcomes.rationale: Prov-GigaPath foundation model trained on real-world pathology — exemplifies FM-as-baseline for biomedical readouts.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Open-weight model usable for pathology-comparable WCM imaging readouts; cellular scope different.

plausible.rationale: Trained on whole-slide imagery with pathology-report integration is methodologically strong.

scalable.rationale: Whole-slide modeling scales to gigapixel images — applicable scaling pattern.

how_to_validate.rationale: Validation across many digital-pathology tasks provides borrowable evaluation suite.

candidates.paper_title: scBERT as a large-scale pretrained deep language model for cell type annotation of single-cell RNA-seq data

useful_outcomes.rationale: scBERT is exactly a single-cell foundation model providing mechanism-agnostic predictions on the same generative biology WCMs target.

immediate_benefit.rationale: WCM teams can adopt scBERT today as ML-side baseline for cell-type/state prediction.

plausible.rationale: Large-scale pretraining on scRNA-seq with transformer architecture is methodologically sound and reproducible.

scalable.rationale: Designed for cross-tissue, cross-species single-cell data — directly scales toward whole-cell complexity.

how_to_validate.rationale: Reports cross-dataset cell-type annotation benchmarks providing concrete validation targets.

candidates.paper_title: Detecting hallucinations in large language models using semantic entropy

useful_outcomes.rationale: Provides hallucination-detection method for LLMs but not directly a WCM-side foundation baseline.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Semantic-entropy approach reusable for filtering bio-FM outputs in joint comparisons.

plausible.rationale: Semantic-entropy estimator with cross-task validation is methodologically robust.

scalable.rationale: Method-agnostic to specific LLM; scales across foundation models.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides concrete uncertainty-based abstention validation protocol.

candidates.paper_title: Structured information extraction from scientific text with large language models

useful_outcomes.rationale: Demonstrates LLM text-extraction in materials science — useful for FM tooling but not WCM ML-side baselines on biology.

immediate_benefit.rationale: Pipeline reusable for curating WCM training data from literature.

plausible.rationale: Fine-tuning GPT-3/Llama on three domain tasks is sound and reproducible.

scalable.rationale: Approach scales across many extraction tasks; broadly applicable.

how_to_validate.rationale: Reports extraction accuracy on representative tasks; less directly tied to ML/MM matching.

candidates.paper_title: Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model

useful_outcomes.rationale: TabPFN is a tabular foundation model that outperforms baselines on small data — relevant for WCM-scale tabular outputs.

immediate_benefit.rationale: TabPFN can be applied today as ML-side baseline on tabular biological readouts.

plausible.rationale: Prior-data-fitted-network training with strong empirical wins is methodologically rigorous.

scalable.rationale: Scales up to 10K samples efficiently; suitable for many WCM-relevant tabular regimes.

how_to_validate.rationale: Provides extensive benchmark comparison against tuned baselines as validation pattern.
